title: 伊莉丝·紫庭长影
description: 伊莉丝穿完整高领长裙静立石庭，背后蛛腿整齐收拢，深红发与暗紫轮廓被侧光清楚切分。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Elise is an adult pale-skinned woman with dark red hair, ruby eyes, a pointed ornamental crown, and articulated spider appendages extending from her back. Preserve the distinctive arachnid silhouette and red-black palette while dressing her in a fully opaque high-collared long-sleeved gown with covered legs. Her face is composed, and the rear limbs remain folded with no fangs, wounds, or frightening spider swarm.
art_direction.scene: She stands upright between two tall plain stone walls, hands relaxed at her waist and folded rear appendages clearly separated behind her shoulders. A narrow hard shaft of evening light catches her hair and crown. Coarse dark wax strokes form decisive dress planes against pale ground, with a single far archway creating depth and no horror or theatrical menace.
art_direction.palette: oxblood red, deep plum, black-violet, pale stone light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
